active_slice: Connected local workbench and integration tests; eleven browser orientation profiles and narrow parser/reflow checks executed. Full workflow browser journeys, prescribed workloads, live inference and human acceptance remain Not run/Blocked.
navigation_notes: Profile/workflow rows below preserve the original P04 script baseline, including its historical blockers. startup.overwrite: Refused unless --overwrite is explicitly supplied; only the named seed file is written.
startup.database: Previously unimplemented by P04; P05 implements PW_EXERCISE=1 and explicit absolute PW_STATE with isolated SQLite/local evidence. Incompatible seed/database and PW_DATA/external evidence are refused.
startup.inference: Blocked: no live provider calls or activation from fixture creation.
